<div class="card-body">
'''Let The Wookiee Win''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ウーキーに勝たせてやれ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：“デジャリックの勝負”で戦闘運命数を1回余分に引く。2：自分の側が敗北したゲームで、ウーキーが生き残った時に使用する。同じ場所にいる相手のキャラクターで能力値＜5のものに配備する。キャラクターは“腕を引っこ抜かれる”（戦闘力－1、加えて武器を持てなくなる）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Let-The-Wookiee-Win-PSA-89673881.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「あんまりウーキーを怒らせるな」「お言葉ですが、ドロイドの機嫌は損ねても構わないとおっしゃるのですか？」「ああ、ドロイドは勝負に負けたって、相手の腕を引っこ抜いたりしないからな」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Let The Wookiee Win.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: During a "dejarik contest," draw one extra battle destiny.

2: Use when a Wookiee survived a game your side lost. Deploy on an opponent's character of ability less than 5 at the same location. The character has an arm ripped out (power -1, and can no longer carry weapons).

'''Lore:'''
Don't upset a Wookiee too much. Sir, are you saying it is fine to upset a droid? Ah, a droid does not rip someone's arm out when it loses.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese labels the two modes after どちらかを選ぶ.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Let The Wookiee Win]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
